        lines = fh.read().splitlines()
    return parse_lines(_expand(lines, path, (os.path.realpath(path),)))


def _expand(lines, path, stack):
    base = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    out = []
    for raw in lines:
        parts = raw.split(None, 1)
        if not parts or parts[0] != "@include":
            out.append(raw)
            continue
        if len(parts) < 2 or not parts[1].strip():
            raise ConfigError("{}: @include requires a path".format(path))
        target = os.path.join(base, parts[1].strip())
        real = os.path.realpath(target)
        if real in stack:
            raise ConfigError("include cycle detected: {}".format(target))
        try:
            with open(target, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                inc_lines = fh.read().splitlines()
        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
            raise ConfigError(
                "{}: cannot include {!r}: {}".format(path, parts[1].strip(), exc)
            )
        out.extend(_expand(inc_lines, target, stack + (real,)))
    return out
''')
